- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to hydrate properly before and during the race, including:
  - Drink 16-20 ounces of water or sports drink 1-2 hours prior to the race.
  - Avoid caffeine and sugary drinks.
  - Drink 4-8 ounces every 20-30 minutes during the race.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant emphasized the importance of monitoring urine color for hydration and experimenting during training.

  - Start slow and steady.
  - Set realistic goals.
  - Use the "talk test."
  - Pay attention to body signals.
  - Use mile markers or splits.
  - Avoid "banking time."
  - Use visualization techniques.
  - Stay focused and present.
  - Draw energy from the crowd.
